description: This is a unit test class for testing LDAP connection functionality in the OrangeHRM system. It contains a test method 'testCreate' that mocks LDAP services to verify LDAP connection and lookup features within the LDAPTestConnectionAPI.

classes.name: LDAPTestConnectionAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing LDAP connection and configuration in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes LDAP server configuration before each test, skipping tests if LDAP server is not configured.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Main test method that creates LDAP settings, mocks LDAP services, and verifies the LDAP connection test API response.

methods.name: getEntryCollection
methods.description: Helper method to create a mocked EntryCollection with specified LDAP entries and lookup settings.

methods.name: getLDAPEntries
methods.description: Helper method to generate an array of LDAP Entry objects from a list of usernames.
